name: systonia/waypoint
description: A lightweight PHP framework for building APIs and server-rendered UIs, with attribute-based routing.

scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.test:ui: npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui test
scripts.check:ui: npm --prefix ui ci --silent && npm --prefix ui run --silent check:bundle

suggest.monolog/monolog: Powerful logging with handlers, channels, and JSON output.
suggest.phpunit/phpunit: Required by the Waypoint\Testing kit for app and plugin tests.
suggest.tenma/psr: Response::upgrade() through the PSR-15 handler under Tenma
